posts.title: Emacs Tree-sitter custom highlighting, part 1
posts.description: A few years ago I blogged about custom tree-sitter-based syntax highlighting in emacs . I started out with highlighting certain keywords in red. I wanted to show the keywords that interrupt control flow: Screenshot showing syntax highlighting of keywords in black or red I highlight regular keywords ( while , if ) in bold. I highlight control flow interrupting keywords ( return , continue ) in red.
